source_metadata.title: A Randomized, Double-Blind Clinical Trial of One vs. Two Doses of High-Dose Influenza Vaccine in Solid Organ Transplant Recipients
source_metadata.source_type: randomized double-blind placebo-controlled single-center clinical trial

extraction_limitations: Extraction was limited to the 22-page accepted-manuscript PDF supplied by the user; supplementary appendix files were not available and no supplementary-table values were atomized.

Clinical-effectiveness inference is intentionally not encoded beyond reported clinical events because the trial was underpowered for clinical effectiveness and only two laboratory-confirmed influenza events occurred.

Holm-adjusted p values are preserved in canonical statements for Table 2 and Table 3 atoms because the current QuantitativeResult schema has a single p-value field and no dedicated multiplicity-adjusted p-value field; the structured p_value field contains the raw p value.
Publication day/month were not reported in the supplied manuscript text, so publication_date is null rather than inferred.
Atoms remain review_status=needs_review pending human verification against the source.
